input.description: Show the diff of the fix

content.text:
Found it: `vitest.config.ts`'s browser project has `deps.optimizer.web` — that was Vitest's pre-v3 key for the dependency optimizer. Since Vitest moved to Vite's Environment API, the browser project runs under the environment named `"client"`, and the resolver only reads `deps.optimizer[environmentName]` (i.e. `client`/`ssr`).
